::: {.about-content}

::: {.about-intro}
Hello! I'm originally from **Dhaka**, the vibrant capital city of Bangladesh. I came to the US in 2015 in pursuit of my bachelor's degree in Computer Science and lived in West Michigan before moving to Northern Virginia in 2022. 

I am currently a **Data Analyst II** at Shift Digital in the Data Operations and Analytics team, where I leverage data-driven solutions for enterprise clients. I graduated with a **Master's of Science in Data Science & Analytics** from Georgetown University in 2025. My passion lies in leveraging tailored data and algorithms to solve intricate business problems and communicating complex insights to non-technical stakeholders.

I love spending time in charming cafes and exploring new cuisines. During my downtime I enjoy reading, painting and watching movies/TV shows.
:::

::: {#timeline-responsive-script}
<script>
// Mobile-optimized timeline with better responsive handling
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    function adjustTimelineLayout() {
        const timelineContainer = document.querySelector('.journey-visual .plotly-graph-div');
        if (!timelineContainer) return;
        
        const screenWidth = window.innerWidth;
        
        // Apply mobile-specific optimizations
        if (screenWidth <= 768) {
            const newLayout = {
                height: 280,
                width: 450, // Compact width for mobile scrolling
                margin: {l: 60, r: 100, t: 15, b: 35},
                'xaxis.range': [-0.3, 0.8]
            };
            
            // Also update annotation positions for mobile
            const mobileAnnotations = timelineContainer._fullLayout.annotations.map(annotation => {
                const newAnnotation = {...annotation};
                
                // Adjust text positioning for mobile
                if (annotation.x > 0) {
                    newAnnotation.x = 0.2; // Move text closer to timeline on mobile
                }
                if (annotation.x < 0) {
                    newAnnotation.x = -0.2; // Move years closer to timeline on mobile
                }
                
                // Reduce font sizes for mobile
                newAnnotation.font = {
                    ...annotation.font,
                    size: Math.max(8, annotation.font.size * 0.8)
                };
                
                return newAnnotation;
            });
            
            newLayout.annotations = mobileAnnotations;
            
            // Apply mobile layout
            if (window.Plotly && timelineContainer._fullLayout) {
                Plotly.relayout(timelineContainer, newLayout);
            }
        }
        // Desktop: Keep the clean minimalistic Python defaults
    }
    
    // Initial adjustment
    setTimeout(adjustTimelineLayout, 200);
    
    // Debounced resize handler
    let resizeTimeout;
    function handleResize() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(adjustTimelineLayout, 100);
    }
    
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function() {
        setTimeout(adjustTimelineLayout, 250);
    });
});
</script>
:::
